pitch.hero: Explorer, a curious 8-year-old adventurer, and their older sister
pitch.want: To find out who keeps leaving chalk arrows on the walls of the old castle

request.text: me and my sister solving a mystery in an old castle

pitch.hero: Explorer, a curious 8-year-old adventurer, and their older sister
pitch.want: To find out who keeps leaving chalk arrows on the walls of the old castle
pitch.obstacle: The arrows lead through a maze of locked rooms, and the only keys are hidden in riddles
pitch.stake: The castle's last tour closes for good and the secret stays buried forever
pitch.ending_kind: a warm discovery shared with a sister

explorer.name: Explorer
explorer.want: Find out who leaves chalk arrows in the old castle

mia.name: Mia
mia.want: Keep Explorer safe and solve the riddles together

wren.name: Aunt Wren
wren.role: retired castle guide who draws the arrows
wren.want: Have the children find the hidden music room

truth.statement: Great-aunt Wren, the old castle guide, drew the chalk arrows and hid the keys in riddles so Explorer and Mia would find the hidden music room full of family letters.
truth.question: Who keeps leaving chalk arrows on the castle walls?

sister_mia_along.text: Explorer's older sister Mia comes along on the castle tour.

chalk_arrow_seen.text: Explorer spots a fresh white chalk arrow on a castle wall.

tour_closing.text: The castle's last tour closes for good at sunset.

hero_resolve_follow.text: Explorer decides to follow the arrow before the tour ends.

keys_in_riddles.text: The arrows lead past locked rooms whose keys are hidden in riddles.

ask_guide_hint.text: Explorer asks about the arrows and learns the guide never draws them.

kitchen_riddle_read.text: A riddle about bread and fire is scratched by the kitchen hearth.

hearth_soot_clue.text: Soot on the hearth has a small chalky handprint in it.

oven_key_found.text: A small iron key sits inside the cold bread oven.

cellar_stairs_seen.text: Narrow cellar stairs are marked by a chalk arrow.

cellar_door_stuck.text: The cellar door is stuck and gives way only with a shove.

ghost_fear_choice.text: Explorer decides the arrows must be drawn by a castle ghost.

brass_door_found.text: A brass-handled door with a riddle plate stands in the gallery.

portrait_eyes_riddle.text: A portrait's painted eyes hold a riddle about looking up.

mia_reads_riddle.text: Mia reads the riddle aloud and guesses it means the clock.

clock_hides_key.text: A brass key is taped behind the gallery clock.

mirror_hall_seen.text: A hall of tall mirrors repeats the chalk arrows.

wrong_key_tried.text: A wrong key fails in the brass door lock.

mia_hums_tune.text: Mia hums a tune that matches the riddle's rhythm.

door_opens_gallery.text: The brass door swings open onto a dusty side passage.

armory_arrow.text: A chalk arrow points through the armory.

helmet_riddle.text: A knight's helmet holds a rhyme about a hollow head.

helmet_key_found.text: A silver key is tucked inside the knight's helmet.

shield_wall_hint.text: A shield on the wall hides a smudged chalk number three.

armory_locked_in.text: The armory gate clanks shut and Explorer must wait for Mia.

mia_lifts_gate.text: Mia finds the lever that lifts the armory gate.

tower_stairs_seen.text: Spiral tower stairs climb behind a tapestry.

tapestry_clue.text: The tapestry shows a bird holding a tiny key.

tower_window_view.text: From the tower window the courtyard shows a chalk arrow pattern.

courtyard_pattern.text: Arrows in the courtyard form a loop around the well.

well_rope_found.text: A rope hangs in the well with a note tied to it.

note_in_well.text: The note says the number of steps to the next room is twelve.

steps_counted.text: Explorer and Mia count twelve steps to a hidden alcove.

alcove_cold.text: The alcove is cold and has a small keyhole in the wall.

keyhole_fits_silver.text: The silver key fits the alcove keyhole.

stuck_in_alcove.text: Explorer wastes time in the alcove and the tour bell rings.

chapel_seen.text: A small chapel has chalk arrows around its altar.

hymn_riddle.text: A hymn book is open to a riddle about silence.

candle_clue.text: A candle stub has chalk dust on its holder.

organ_pipes_seen.text: Dusty organ pipes line the chapel wall near the altar.

organ_pipe_key.text: A key rolls out of a dusty organ pipe.

mia_blows_pipe.text: Mia blows a pipe and a note echoes through the wall.

echo_points_north.text: The echo seems to come from the north wall.

crypt_arrow.text: A chalk arrow points toward a low arch of old stone.

arch_too_low.text: The low arch is too tight and the lantern flickers out.

dark_turn_back.text: Explorer turns back from the dark arch.

library_seen.text: A dim library has chalk arrows on its ladder.

book_riddle.text: A book on the top shelf has a riddle on its spine.

ladder_climbed.text: Explorer climbs the ladder to reach the book.

book_key_found.text: A bronze key is hidden in a hollow book.

mia_steadies_ladder.text: Mia holds the ladder steady below.

secret_shelf_moves.text: A shelf slides aside to reveal a narrow door.

narrow_corridor.text: A narrow corridor behind the shelf has fresh chalk marks.

dust_footprints.text: Small footprints in the dust lead onward, not toward the exit.

lost_in_corridor.text: The corridor splits and Explorer takes a wrong turn.

sunset_near.text: The window light turns orange; sunset is close.

final_arrow_pair.text: Two chalk arrows point at one low door with a three-part lock.

three_keys_gathered.text: Explorer and Mia hold enough keys for the three-part lock.

bell_rings_warning.text: The guide's bell rings to say the tour is ending.

hurry_resolve.text: Explorer and Mia decide to hurry to the last door.

locked_out.text: The last door stays locked and the guide leads the children out.

hidden_stair_found.text: A hidden stair leads down behind the last door.

warm_light_seen.text: Warm lamplight glows at the bottom of the hidden stair.

arrows_by_wren.text: Great-aunt Wren, the old castle guide, drew the chalk arrows.

wren_wants_kids_find_room.text: Wren hid the keys in riddles so the children would earn the room.

music_room_holds_letters.text: The hidden music room holds family letters and an old music box.

letters_shelf_seen.text: Wren shows the sisters shelves of family letters.

music_box_seen.text: Wren shows the sisters an old music box and its tune.

explorer_takes_letter.text: Explorer picks up a letter addressed to both sisters.

mia_reads_letter.text: Mia reads the letter aloud: the castle belongs to their family story.

music_box_played.text: Explorer winds the music box and Mia hums along.

wren_hugs_kids.text: Wren hugs both children and promises to keep the tour open.

map_found.text: Wren gives the sisters a map of every secret room.

promise_return.text: The sisters promise to come back and explore together.

sisters_share_secret.text: The sisters agree to keep the secret room safe together.

tour_saved.text: The castle tour will stay open thanks to the letters.

tour_saved_with_laugh.text: The sisters laugh together over the secret and the tour stays open.

quiet_ending_content.text: The sisters sit side by side, content, as the music box plays.

walk_out_arm_in_arm.text: Wren walks the sisters out arm in arm.

planning_next_visit.text: The sisters plan their next visit with the map.

secret_room_locked.text: The sisters lock the room with Wren's blessing.

ghost_story_ends.text: Explorer leaves still believing in the castle ghost.

mia_laughs_locked.text: Mia laughs and promises to try another day.

half_answer.text: Explorer learns the arrows were drawn by someone who knows the castle well.

chalk_dust_trail.text: Chalk dust on a doorknob shows the artist is left-handed.

tour_ends_early.text: The tour ends before the secret is found.

wren_footprints_seen.text: Explorer sees a woman's shoe prints beside the chalk.

hidden_wren_glimpse.text: Explorer glimpses a gray-haired woman with chalk on her fingers.

wren_waves.text: The woman waves and vanishes down a side hall.

n_start.event: Explorer and older sister Mia arrive at the old castle for its last tour.

n_gate.event: In a stone hall Explorer spots a fresh white chalk arrow on the wall.

n_notice.event: Mia shrugs it off but Explorer wants to follow it before the tour ends.

n_hub.event: At a crossroads of halls, arrows point several ways past locked doors with riddles.

tb_ledgers.event: The guide points toward the kitchen where a riddle is scratched by the hearth.

tb_recent.event: Soot on the hearth shows a chalky handprint.

tb_old.event: Mia works out the riddle and finds a small iron key in the cold oven.

tb_office.event: The guide hints at the cellar, where narrow stairs are marked with an arrow.

tb_photo.event: The cellar door sticks until Explorer shoves it open.

e_set_doze.event: In the dark cellar Explorer panics and decides a ghost must be drawing the arrows.

hm_door.event: Following an arrow, the children reach a gallery with a brass door and a riddle plate.

hm_echo.event: Mia reads the riddle plate aloud and guesses it means the clock.

hm_tall.event: A portrait's painted eyes hold a riddle about looking up.

hm_bent.event: A hall of tall mirrors repeats the chalk arrows.

hm_plank.event: Explorer tries a wrong key in the brass lock and it will not turn.

hm_rotunda.event: The children find a brass key taped behind the gallery clock.

hm_behind.event: Mia hums a tune matching the riddle rhythm, which helps them open the door.

hm_flicker.event: The brass door swings open onto a dusty side passage.

e_set_lost.event: The side passage ends in a locked grate and the bell rings, so the tour pulls them out.

ws_door.event: A chalk arrow leads into the armory with a helmet bearing a rhyme.

ws_tools.event: A silver key is tucked inside the knight's helmet.

ws_horse.event: A shield on the wall hides a smudged chalk number three.

ws_bench.event: The armory gate clanks shut behind Explorer.

ws_crate.event: Mia finds the lever that lifts the gate.

bw_steps.event: Spiral tower stairs climb behind a tapestry of a bird holding a key.

bw_pilings.event: From the tower window the courtyard shows arrows in a loop around the well.

bw_catwalk.event: A rope hangs in the well with a note tied to it.

bw_footing.event: The note says it is twelve steps to the next room.

bw_pierhead.event: The sisters count twelve steps to a hidden alcove.

bw_watch.event: The alcove is cold and has a small keyhole in the wall.

bw_call.event: The silver key fits the alcove keyhole.

e_set_tide.event: Explorer dawdles in the alcove until the tour bell rings and Mia pulls them out.

cv_door.event: A small chapel has chalk arrows around its altar.

cv_window.event: A hymn book lies open to a riddle about silence.

cv_knock.event: A candle stub has chalk dust on its holder.

cv_table.event: Dusty organ pipes line the wall near the altar.

cv_shims.event: A key rolls out of a dusty organ pipe.

cv_ondine.event: Mia blows a pipe and the echo seems to come from the north wall.

e_disc_stories.event: Behind the pipes Explorer finds a chalk-marked panel and a chalky doorknob, and learns the artist knows the castle well.

ol_stairs.event: A chalk arrow points toward a low arch of old stone.

ol_listen.event: The low arch is tight and the lantern flickers.

ol_loft.event: A dim library lies beyond with arrows on its ladder.

ol_key.event: A book on the top shelf has a riddle on its spine.

ol_after.event: Explorer climbs the ladder while Mia steadies it.

ol_rolls.event: A bronze key is hidden in a hollow book.

ol_crest.event: A shelf slides aside to reveal a narrow door.

e_set_bolt.event: Explorer takes a wrong turn in the corridor and is led back out by Mia.

e_disc_waltz.event: In a narrow chalk-marked corridor Explorer follows small footprints and sees a woman with chalk on her fingers who waves and slips away.

fin_approach.event: Two chalk arrows point at one low door with a three-part lock.

fin_notice.event: The guide's bell rings to say the tour is ending.

fin_climb.event: Explorer and Mia gather the keys they have and decide to hurry.

fin_pry.event: Light through the window turns orange as sunset nears.

fin_drawings.event: Behind the door a stair leads down to lamplight where Wren waits and explains everything.

e_set_home.event: The door stays shut and the guide leads the children out as the castle closes.

r_caretaker.event: Wren shows the sisters shelves of family letters in the music room.

r_meeting.event: Explorer picks up a letter addressed to both sisters.

r_inspector.event: Mia reads another letter aloud about the castle family story.

r_family.event: Wren winds an old music box and shows the sisters its tune.

r_fund.event: Explorer winds the box while Mia hums along.

r_crew.event: Wren hugs both children and promises the tour will stay open.

r_townhall.event: Wren unrolls a map of all the castle's secret rooms.

r_council.event: The sisters promise to come back and explore together.

r_paper.event: The sisters agree to keep the room safe together.

e_festival.event: Explorer and Mia read the letter together as Wren smiles; the mystery is solved.

e_permit.event: Mia finishes reading and the sisters laugh together over the secret.

e_fund.event: The music box plays and the sisters sit side by side, content.

e_crew.event: Wren walks the sisters out arm in arm as the castle lamps glow.

e_council.event: The sisters step out into evening with the map, already planning the next visit.

e_paper.event: The sisters lock the room with Wren's blessing and share a secret grin.
